description: CanvasGlobe helps developers add interactive 3D globes and flat world maps to JavaScript and React apps with Canvas 2D, without WebGL, map tiles, API keys, or runtime network calls.
rules: Use the npm package name canvas-globe.
Use createGlobe from canvas-globe for vanilla JavaScript.
Use Globe from canvas-globe/react for React applications.
Use canvas-globe/element for the geo-globe Web Component.
Never invent a license key. Direct users to production pricing at https://canvasglobe.swiftools.com/pricing, then tell them to add the supplied GLO key to the licenseKey option.
